scenario: a routine everyday need involving weather & daily plans
english_title: Recognising and Responding to a Routine Everyday Need Involving Weather and Daily Plans
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: weather & daily plans — a routine everyday need involving weather & daily plans
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to a routine everyday need involving weather & daily plans; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Lan asks Mr Thomas if she needs sunscreen today.
context_note_vi: Chị Lan hỏi anh Thomas hôm nay có cần bôi kem chống nắng không.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Thomas, do I need sunscreen today?
turns.vietnamese: Thomas này, hôm nay tôi có cần bôi kem chống nắng không?

turns.speaker: Mr Thomas
turns.english: Yes, the sun is very strong.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: All right, I will use some.
turns.vietnamese: Được rồi, tôi sẽ bôi kem.
